articles.title: Record University Acceptances, But Fewer First Choices: The 2026 Results Day Story
articles.summary: A-level results day 2026 brought a record number of UK 18-year-olds into university, yet the first-choice acceptance rate dipped. Financial pressures loom for both students and institutions.

articles.title: Tariff Evasion Costs US Billions: White House Blames Transshipment
articles.summary: The Trump administration claims countries are dodging US tariffs by transshipping goods through third nations, costing up to $26 billion annually. China is singled out, with new AI tools deployed to catch cheats.

articles.title: Record Heat Bakes UK and Europe: Hospitals, Wildfires, and Drought
articles.summary: The UK hit 38.1°C on Thursday, its hottest day of 2026, as Europe endures its fifth heat wave. Nurses are collapsing, wildfires rage, and a rare drought order is pending.
